heroHeadline: US Pledges $1 Billion in Security Assistance to Colombia's De La Espriella
heroSubtitle: Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in August 7 in Cali — Colombia's first inauguration outside Bogotá — vowing to abandon Total Peace for a US-backed military offensive, after police intercepted a bus loaded with explosives near the ceremony and a car bomb hit Cauca the next day, both blamed on FARC dissidents; Gustavo Petro left office still alleging fraud and warning of 'civil war.' A 7.4-magnitude earthquake near San José del Palmar, Chocó then killed at least 20 people on August 10.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, Registraduría Nacional, and major international outlets.
